reason: The hypothesis combines the finding that dilute carbon doping forms carbides in a refractory HEA under high pressure (P11) with the concept of interstitial carbon improving strength-ductility synergy via multiple mechanisms (P16) and the observation of carbide strengthening in a refractory HEA with 0.3 at.% C (P24). It transfers this idea to a Nb-based refractory HEA using ambient-pressure annealing to achieve discrete nanoscale carbides, which none of the passages explicitly proposes. The specific alloy system, processing route, and predicted outcome are a synthesis of these sources, but the core idea of using dilute carbon to form discrete carbides in a Nb-based RHEA for strength-ductility synergy is largely a direct extension of the cited works.
